# Vendor Security Assessment 2024 — Completed

# | Question | Response
1 | Do you hold a recognised information security certification? | Yes. Acme Corp is ISO 27001:2022 certified, recertified by BSI in March 2025. The certificate is available on request.
2 | How is customer data protected at rest? | All customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256. Keys are managed in AWS KMS and rotated annually.
3 | Do you enforce multi-factor authentication for production access? | Yes. MFA is mandatory for all production access, and access reviews are carried out quarterly by the Head of Security.
4 | ما هي مدة الاحتفاظ ببيانات العملاء؟ | يتم الاحتفاظ ببيانات العملاء لمدة سبع سنوات وفقاً للمتطلبات التنظيمية، ثم يتم حذفها بشكل آمن.
